description.description: One line on what it is.

base_dir.description: The folder a relative path in the configuration is made from, when the store has one (the file's directory).

name.description: The file name the format of the configuration is told by (`canoa.cfg`), when it is a file.

id.description: Its id, which [`Layer`] and [`Held`] name it by: 1 to 64 letters, digits, `-`, `_` and `.`.

label.description: What the person is told it is ("the installed canoa.cfg", "your canoa.cfg").

origin.description: Where it lives, for the person to go and change it there when it is not writable (a path, an address).

writable.description: Whether [`ConfigStore::change`] writes it. Exactly one layer of a store is.

origin.description: Where it lives, for the person to go and change it there when it is not writable (a path, an address).

id.description: The layer's id, as [`StoreInfo::layers`] names it.

document.description: What it holds: a map of tables, as the host reads them. An absent layer (a file that does not exist yet) is an empty map.

path.description: The keys from the top, at least one.

value.description: The value of the highest layer that names the path (a table is the highest layer's table whole), or absent.

layer.description: The id of the layer it comes from, or absent when no layer names it.

expect_revision.description: The revision these ops were made from: the change is refused when the store is at another now, so a writer never overwrites what changed after it read.

check_only.description: Answer what the writable layer would hold and write nothing.
